audience: restoration contractors and insurance adjusters that manage property claims in Encircle

useCases.title: Find a property claim and read its details
useCases.text: List the claims this key can see, newest first, or filter them by policyholder name. Open one claim for its loss, insurer and estimate details.

useCases.title: Review moisture and dehumidifier readings by room
useCases.text: List the structures and rooms of a claim. Then read the moisture and dehumidifier readings, and filter them by room.

useCases.title: Find the photos and files of a claim
useCases.text: List the photos, videos and other files attached to a claim, with their download links and capture times.

useCases.title: Add a site visit note to a claim
useCases.text: List the notes of a claim first. Then add a new note with a title or Markdown text. The tool adds a note only and cannot edit or delete notes.
